title: Automated Code Efficiency Optimization via Agent Skill Mining
abstract: arXiv:2603.27850v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Code efficiency is a fundamental aspect of software quality, yet how to use large language models (LLMs) to optimize correct programs remains challenging. Prior approaches rely on one-shot rewriting, retrieved exemplars or instructions, fine-tuning, or candidate search. In this paper, we present EffiSkill, a two-stage framework that models recurring slow-to-fast transformations as Operator Skills: persistent cards that record a transformation's intent, applicability, procedure, expected effect, and risks. Stage I distills frozen, language-specific skill libraries from slow/fast program pairs. Stage II diagnoses a new program, retrieves relevant skills, composes alternative plans, and generates up to eight candidates. These steps finish without candidate-execution feedback; public tests then filter and rank candidates, and held-out private tests determine reported correctness and speedup. Across 623 EffiBench-X tasks per languag

translated_title: 基于智能体技能挖掘的代码效率自动优化
translated_abstract: 代码效率是软件质量的一个基本方面，然而如何利用大语言模型（LLM）来优化已经正确的程序仍然具有挑战性。先前的方法依赖于一次性重写、检索示例或指令、微调或候选搜索等手段。在本文中，我们提出了EffiSkill，这是一个两阶段框架，它将反复出现的“慢代码到快代码”转换建模为算子技能：即持久化的卡片，其中记录了每次转换的意图、适用条件、操作流程、预期效果和风险。阶段一从慢/快程序对中提炼出冻结的、针对特定编程语言的技能库。阶段二对新的程序进行诊断，检索相关技能，组合出多种备选优化方案，并生成最多八个候选程序。这些步骤的完成无需候选程序的执行反馈；随后使用公开测试来过滤和排序候选程序，再用留出的私有测试来确定所报告的正确性和加速比。在每种语言623个EffiBench-X任务上……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出EffiSkill两阶段框架，将慢代码到快代码的常见转换挖掘并沉淀为记录意图、适用性、流程、效果与风险的“算子技能”卡片库，使LLM无需执行反馈即可诊断程序、检索技能并生成多个候选优化方案，从而自动提升代码效率。
